article.title: 更進新聞：Genie 4向合資格Ultra訂戶推出互動世界生成
article.summary: Google開始向合資格AI Ultra訂戶推出Genie 4，讓使用者在瀏覽器探索並修改生成的互動世界。
highlights: 使用者可在場景中以文字改變天氣、加入角色，音訊亦會隨場景變動。
AI Pro用戶可登記候補；Google列出延遲、物理互動及場景持續性等研究限制。
article.why: 互動概念設計團隊可評估即時改場景能否支援提案探索，再決定是否投入製作可交付的體驗。
article.next_step: 先列一段品牌體驗需要保留的物件和視角，取得資格後測試持續性，並記錄哪些改動會破壞場景。
article.detail: Google同時加入Project Genie創作助理與社群作品庫，讓使用者以對話建立世界或探索其他人的作品。公司表示，生成的影片和音訊均帶有SynthID浮水印，Genie 3及Genie 4仍屬前沿研究。品牌團隊可以把探索結果整理為概念參考，並在確定交付方式前逐項核對穩定性及使用條款。
article.title_en: Update: Genie 4 reaches eligible Ultra users for interactive world generation
article.summary_en: Google began rolling out Genie 4 to eligible AI Ultra subscribers for exploring and editing generated worlds in a browser.
highlights_en: Users can change weather or add characters by prompting mid-session, with audio adapting to the scene.
AI Pro users can join a waitlist. Google lists latency, physical interaction and scene-persistence limits.
article.why_en: Interactive concept teams can assess live scene editing for proposal exploration before committing to a deliverable experience.
article.next_step_en: Define the objects and viewpoints a brand experience must preserve, then test persistence once eligible and record disruptive changes.
article.detail_en: Google also added a Project Genie creation agent and a community gallery. Generated audio and video carry SynthID watermarks, and Genie 3 and 4 remain research models. Teams can use explorations as concept references and check stability and terms before choosing a delivery format.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
article.followup: 10月28日本刊報道Genie 4的可信測試者預覽。這次新增合資格Ultra訂戶入口、創作助理及作品庫。
article.followup_en: Our October 28 issue covered the trusted-tester preview. This update adds eligible Ultra access, a creation agent and a gallery.
